title: Remembered vs recorded

rows.remembered: Index composition / dedup was the simplifying win.
rows.recorded: Dedup (G3) LOST 14.43 pts print@1 (p = 0.00034) and was killed. The flat gallery + language head shipped instead (print@1 67.66 → 77.61%).
The bar first appears 09-11 19:37 PDT (evening plan); 09-13 is a restatement.
On replay (41 scenes) the vote scored 26/41 vs 31/41 for one padded crop — the win didn’t hold.
Small-sample high. The pooled 87-lot run gives 71.3% overall, 65.2% on non-locked lots.

rows.recorded: Founder corrected it: not concurrent. Four sequential acts, each begun for a stated reason.
